name: Shimazu Shota
source: Class rep for Shore Thing!!, who is also an arrogant member of the soccer club. Is currently dating Saegusa (the Cultural Team secretary), but it becomes apparent during the Content Restriction Meeting that he’s a bit too chummy with another girl.
